songs.lyrics:
[A Cappella Hook]
Autumn Came Home

[Verse 1]
I stepped outside and stopped there smiling
The first cold morning touched my sleeve
Yesterday's street had changed its clothing
Red on the curb, gold in the leaves
A neighbor's window caught the color
And threw it softly toward the stone
The doorstep chilled the soles beneath me
And made me pull my collar close

[Chorus]
I did not ask for wonders
Autumn Came Home
The air grew clean around me
And I felt glad alone
No sermon from the heavens
Just color near the road

[Verse 2]
My cup was cooling on the sill
The kettle rested after steam
I stood and watched the whole block turning
As if I had walked into a dream
No grand surprise, no thunder
Just thanks beneath my coat
A folded letter on the hall stand
Waited for some later hour
Maples burned above the sidewalk

[Instrumental Break]

[Final Chorus]
Autumn Came Home
I did not ask for wonders
The air grew clean around me
And gratitude spoke low
Autumn Came Home

songs.lyrics:
[Cold Hook]
Close Your Eyes, Winter

[Verse 1]
I threw each window open wide
And heard the house breathe out at last
The rooms let go of winter dust
The heavy weeks moved past
A soft green scent blew through the curtains
And crossed the table where I stood
One hinge complained, then forgave me
Another answered down the hall

[Chorus]
The whole old house felt lighter
Close Your Eyes, Winter
Spring stepped in without hurry
And turned the afternoon tender
The rooms remembered breathing
After months of holding on

[Verse 2]
I folded blankets from the rocker
And set them by the cedar chest
Sun found the cup I had forgotten
And warmed the place my hand had pressed
No trumpet call, no grand arrival
Just air enough for peace
I found a letter by the kettle
Soft with dust along the rim

[Instrumental Break]

[Final Chorus]
Close Your Eyes, Winter
The whole old house felt lighter
Spring stepped in without hurry
And gave my heart release
Close Your Eyes, Winter
